title: Taiwanese American Professionals San Francisco
content_html: Taiwanese American Professionals San Francisco (TAP-SF) is a chapter of the Taiwanese American Citizens League (TACL), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit run entirely by volunteers. One of the largest TAP chapters, TAP-SF includes over 2,500 young professionals in the Bay Area. The chapter organizes programming centered on professional development, cultural engagement, and community service. TAP-SF also produces the Taiwanese American Cultural Festival (TACF), the West Coast’s largest Taiwanese American cultural celebration, which has been held annually since 1993 and draws over 10,000 visitors each year to San Francisco.
